notes.subject: לא יתנו
notes.rationale: 'Their deeds do not permit them' (KJV/ASV) vs 'they do not give/depose' — the verb נתן is ambiguous with מעלליהם as subject or object.

notes.subject: ruah
notes.rationale: רוח היא ruah — one Hebrew word covering spirit/wind/breath; kept as ruah, not split.

notes.subject: spirit of whoredoms
notes.rationale: רוח זנונים is Hebrew idiom for idolatry-inclination; rendered literally as javorái-ruah.

notes.subject: זנונים / ידעו
notes.rationale: 'Know' ידעו is covenant-intimacy language paired with harlotry זנונים — the pun on knowing is structural.

translation: Ndaipóri chupekuéra pe jevy hug̃uã ojere hag̃ua hikuái iñElohim jarýpe, pytu javorái-ruah oĩgui hikuái apytépe, ha ⟨את⟩ Jahve che akãme noñañãmonguái.
